_comment: A broken deep cavalry block whose front rank starts only 40 wu short of a hill gets round it with no man held on the face. Team 1's 80 horses (default Cavalry geometry: 9 files by 9 ranks, about 320 wu wide and 960 wu deep, rank pitch 120 wu) spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale 1.0) facing south, their own back edge, with their front rank at y 1180 and a hill (block terrain, x 780-1040, y 1220-1420) across the eastern half of the block. This is deep-router-rounds-hill.json's staging with the hill moved 180 wu closer. Each man runs for his own back edge on his own (SoldierFlightStep); when he looks round and sees rock along his way as far as he can see, he runs the open way nearest it (SoldierLookRound.way_round_rock), and a man whose run would still carry him onto the hill veers along its face (SoldierBodies.router_terrain_avoid). Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4 (identical: nothing here draws on the seed), measured 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch: no man is at the hill's face or inside it at any sampled tick from tick 120 on (pinned at ticks 240, 300 and 350). The unit's position reads the men's centroid while they rout: (819.94, 706.47) at tick 8 (a setup pin: the spawn) and (714.0, 962.5) at tick 240 (pinned). The bottom-up flight (#1949) removed the anchor these pinned at (819.8, 700.3) and (687.3, 811.1), the block side-step along the face, and the slot grid the slot_distance_max pins (0 within 120 wu at ticks 300 and 350, #1924, #1934) measured: a routed man has no slot. A routing unit's rout timer (6 s) runs out at tick 360 and it rallies; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that. A small idle team-0 squadron 600 wu east keeps the router in the close sim tier; all_teams_control leaves both sides without AI. Flat declared map apart from the hill; drill mode. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
